title: Identify the curve
text: The equation $$\frac{x^2}{16}-\frac{y^2}{9}=1$$ is a hyperbola centered at the origin with $$a=4$$ and $$b=3$$.

title: Find the asymptotes
text: The asymptotes of this hyperbola are $$y=\frac{b}{a} x$$ and $$y=-\left(\frac{b}{a}\right) x$$, which are $$y=\frac{3}{4} x$$ and $$y=-\left(\frac{3}{4}\right) x$$.
